subject: app shown undeployed but looks normal

messages.author: 26b647b408a2e02e
messages.subject: app shown undeployed but looks normal
parts:
My app used to work normal in shinyapps.io. Today I want to change the url/entrypoint and found I have to deploy an new app. I deployed it and everything looks normal, except the app is shown as "undeployed" in dashboard. The log doesn't have any error.

Besides, the app title is webapp, but the actual app name just keep changing to webapp2, webapp3, ... even I deleted all previous deployed apps. How can I reset this and get app name as just webapp?

This is actually a bug in our system. The first time you deploy and application it will show as "undeployed" even though its actually running. We're going to push out a fix today. Sorry for the confusion!

-Andy
